title: cosmo_fate: A locally preregistered fragility audit of DESI-era cosmic-fate claims
description: Reproducibility archive for "Is cosmic fate an inference or an assumption?" Version 2.0.0 adds the completed 500-mock null calibration and truth-specific power study, the calibrated seven-node information-localization analysis, and the fixed-history future-continuation partial-identification audit. It also records the author-directed computational-feasibility closure of the unstarted WP4 nested verification and the endpoint-blind, unconverged WP5 production campaign; neither incomplete package contributes a scientific endpoint. The archive retains the locally preregistered secondary-data analysis plan, append-only amendments, code, reported endpoint artifacts, manuscript source, and submission PDF. The plan was frozen in local version control before the first fate result; the public repository was created later, so this is not described as a third-party-registry preregistration.
